reviews.title: Good keyboard all in all
reviews.comment:
In good condition, sounds good with the basic switches.
Clacky sound to it, the only thing that's ok about it is that the casing is plastic and you need to buy pudding keycaps to really see the light because it does not shine through the default keycaps.
